scopes.g: global: the same value on every process
scopes.l: local: each process has its own

templates.note: A type starting with T or R takes the routine’s precision, the letter at the ? of its family (p?gesv: pdgesv is d): T is its own type, R the real type of the same precision.

tags.wsq: documents a workspace query: called with LWORK = -1 (or LIWORK, LRWORK), it only computes the workspace sizes
tags.desc: takes array descriptors (DESCA, …): set them up with DESCINIT, and the local sizes with NUMROC
tags.info: returns INFO: 0 on success; -(i*100+j) when entry j of array argument i is illegal, -i for a scalar argument i
tags.coll: every process in the scope (row, column or grid) must call it

fields.g: precision family; its record in `groups` holds the defaults, and a key ending in c is the default for the complex members (c, z)
fields.l: library (see libraries), when it is not scalapack
fields.v: Netlib member-page anchor in the file’s page
fields.U: Netlib member page, when it does not follow the rule
fields.f: source file, when it is not <name>.f

netlib.rule: as in lapack.json: file escaped as Doxygen does, dir from the md5 of the escaped name
